activateExtensionNote.description: Shortcuts section note clarifying Chrome’s Activate the extension command.

privacyProse.message: PlaybackKeys 不收集任何数据。没有遥测、没有网络请求、没有分析。设置保存在你设备上的 chrome.storage 中。源代码位于 github.com/mehmetdemircs/PlaybackKeys。

confirmResetDefaults.message: 要将所有 PlaybackKeys 设置重置为默认值吗？这不会移除已授予的网站权限。

onboardingDefaultChordsHint.message: 底部三个推荐快捷键默认留空。你可以在 Chrome 快捷键设置中分配它们，或在设置中调整跳转间隔和速度步进。
onboardingDefaultChordsHint.description: Onboarding helper text. Contains trusted extension HTML.

onboardingMacCallout.message: 跳转使用 8 和 9，因为 macOS 将 ⌘⇧3 到 ⌘⇧6 用于截图。你可以在 chrome://extensions/shortcuts 中重新绑定任何快捷键。
onboardingMacCallout.description: Onboarding macOS note. Contains trusted extension HTML.

onboardingNonMacCallout.message: 跳转默认使用 3 和 4。你可以在 chrome://extensions/shortcuts 中重新绑定任何快捷键。
onboardingNonMacCallout.description: Onboarding non-macOS note. Contains trusted extension HTML.

chromeOsGlobalCommandsNote.message: 提示：ChromeOS 不支持全局命令。在那里，只有 Chrome 窗口获得焦点时快捷键才会生效。

useItOnAnyVideoSite.message: 在任何视频网站上使用

useItOnAnyVideoSiteDesc.description: Onboarding helper text. Contains trusted extension HTML.

skipIntervalsDesc.message: 三种跳转长度，各自拥有后退 / 前进命令
skipIntervalsDesc.description: Settings group description for the three Skip intervals.

ahkWindowsOnly.description: Muted one-line note shown on non-Windows instead of the full AHK bridge configurator.

ahkBridgeTitle.description: AHK bridge panel title on the options Shortcuts section.

ahkBridgeDesc.message: 高级 · 可选 — 将 External hotkey 映射到 Command
ahkBridgeDesc.description: AHK bridge panel short description marking the feature as advanced and optional.

ahkBridgeNote.message: 为 Command 录制系统级 External hotkey，然后下载一份 AHK bridge script。尚无 Chrome 目标快捷键的行仍可录制；在绑定之前，它们会在脚本中被跳过。
ahkBridgeNote.description: AHK bridge panel helper note for External hotkey recording and download.

ahkBridgeGuidance.message: 安装 AutoHotkey v2，下载脚本并运行（可选随 Windows 启动）。请在 Chrome 快捷键设置中将每个 Command 保持为 Global，以便在其他应用处于前台时，SendInput 仍能送达 PlaybackKeys。
ahkBridgeGuidance.description: Brief AutoHotkey v2 install/run guidance plus reminder that Commands must remain Global in Chrome.

ahkBrowserGateLabel.description: User-facing Browser gate toggle label (equivalent of 仅在有浏览器时拦截).

ahkBrowserGateDesc.message: Browser gate — 默认开启。关闭后，在 AHK bridge script 运行期间会系统级占用 External hotkey。
ahkBrowserGateDesc.description: Helper text under the Browser gate toggle explaining default-on and global-claim trade-off.

ahkBridgePathsGuidance.message: 路径 A：保持 Browser gate 开启；若在提权游戏前台下 External hotkey 失效，请以管理员身份运行 AHK bridge script（或在 Download 前开启可选的自提权）。路径 B：关闭 Browser gate，无需提权即可系统级捕获（脚本运行期间会在所有应用中吞掉这些按键）。
ahkBridgePathsGuidance.description: AHK panel dual-path guidance from ADR-0006: elevate with gate on (manual or optional self-elevation), or gate off for global claim.

ahkSelfElevateLabel.message: 启动时请求管理员权限（可选）
ahkSelfElevateLabel.description: User-facing optional self-elevation toggle label for the AHK bridge panel.

ahkSelfElevateDesc.message: 自提权 — 可选，默认关闭。开启后，Download 会嵌入 UAC 重启逻辑，使 AHK bridge script 能匹配提权前台应用（路径 A）。与 Browser gate 互补，不能替代路径 B。
ahkSelfElevateDesc.description: Helper text under the self-elevation toggle explaining default-off and Path A complementarity.

ahkClearMappings.description: Button that clears all External hotkey mappings, Bridge toggle hotkey, Browser gate, self-elevation, and related AHK bridge snapshot state.

ahkClearMappingsConfirm.message: 确定清除所有 External hotkey 映射、重映射开/关热键、Browser gate、自提权以及 AHK bridge 下载快照状态？
ahkClearMappingsConfirm.description: Confirm dialog before clearing all AHK bridge companion storage, including the Bridge toggle hotkey, Browser gate, and self-elevation.

ahkRecordExternal.description: Button to start External hotkey capture for a Command.

ahkClearExternal.description: Button to clear one Command External hotkey mapping.

ahkChromeTargetMissing.message: 缺少 Chrome 目标快捷键
ahkChromeTargetMissing.description: Shown when a Command has an External hotkey row but no chrome.commands shortcut yet.

ahkHighCollisionWarn.message: 此 External hotkey 是常用按键。在可用的浏览器窗口存在时，AutoHotkey 会全局吞掉它。仍然绑定吗？
ahkHighCollisionWarn.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision External hotkey with Browser gate on.

ahkHighCollisionWarnGateOff.message: 此 External hotkey 是常用按键。在 AHK bridge script 运行期间，AutoHotkey 会在所有应用中吞掉它。仍然绑定吗？
ahkHighCollisionWarnGateOff.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision External hotkey with Browser gate off (stronger global swallow warning).

ahkDownload.description: Button to download the generated AutoHotkey v2 AHK bridge script.

ahkDownloadDisabledReason.message: 至少需要一个已有 Chrome 目标快捷键的 Command，并为其录制 External hotkey。
ahkDownloadDisabledReason.description: Shown beside Download when no complete External hotkey + Command chord row exists.

ahkSkipUnboundReason.message: 已从脚本跳过（Chrome 目标未绑定）：$1
ahkSkipUnboundReason.description: Explains which mapped Commands are omitted from active AHK hotkey lines. $1 is a comma-separated Command list.

ahkDriftHint.message: 自上次下载后，AHK bridge 设置或 Chrome Command 快捷键已更改。请重新生成 AHK bridge script。
ahkDriftHint.description: Dismissible hint beside Download when Browser gate or live chrome.commands chords drift from the last generate snapshot.

ahkDriftDismiss.description: Dismiss the AHK chord-drift regenerate hint.

ahkBridgeToggleLabel.description: Friendly label for the optional Bridge toggle hotkey row in the AHK panel.

ahkBridgeToggleDesc.message: 可选 — 开启或关闭 External hotkey 重映射，且不会禁用此键本身
ahkBridgeToggleDesc.description: Helper text under the remaps on/off hotkey row.

ahkNoBridgeToggle.description: Empty placeholder when no remaps on/off hotkey is recorded.

ahkBridgeToggleConflict.message: 该键已用作 External hotkey。请选择其他重映射开/关热键。
ahkBridgeToggleConflict.description: Reject saving a Bridge toggle hotkey that collides with an External hotkey.

ahkExternalConflictsWithBridgeToggle.message: 该键已用作重映射开/关热键。请选择其他 External hotkey。
ahkExternalConflictsWithBridgeToggle.description: Reject saving an External hotkey that collides with the Bridge toggle hotkey.

ahkBridgeToggleHighCollisionWarn.message: 此键是常用按键。在 AHK bridge script 运行期间，AutoHotkey 会全局吞掉它。仍然绑定吗？
ahkBridgeToggleHighCollisionWarn.description: One-shot confirm when binding a high-collision Bridge toggle hotkey (global while script runs).

ahkUnsupportedKey.message: 不支持该按键，请换一个。
ahkUnsupportedKey.description: 录制 External hotkey / Bridge toggle 时遇到无法映射的键，保持录制并给出短提示。
